# SPORTX

> SPORTX는 Nike, Adidas, Puma, New Balance 등 정품 스포츠화 및 패션 신발을 국내외 배송으로 제공하는 프리미엄 온라인 스토어입니다.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured sneakers, new arrivals, and best sellers.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse all authentic sneakers and sportswear by brand and category.
- [About](/about): SPORTX brand story, authenticity guarantee, and commitments.
- [Contact](/contact): Customer support and inquiries.
- [Cart](/cart): Shopping cart.
- [Checkout](/checkout): Order checkout with KakaoPay, NaverPay, and bank transfer.
